name: What interior renovations offer the best return on investment?

mainEntity.name: What interior renovations offer the best return on investment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen and bathroom remodels often provide the highest return on investment for interior home renovations. These areas are critical to daily living and property value, making upgrades appealing to potential buyers. For example, a minor kitchen remodel can recoup a significant portion of its cost, while bathroom additions also tend to perform well. When planning, consider how the renovation aligns with the current market trends and the overall style of homes in the East Bay area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen and bathroom remodels generally offer the best return on investment due to their impact on daily living and property value.
